example.title: Four Seasons Hotel Westlake Village (2006), front
example.place: Westlake Village, Los Angeles County, CA

brief: A 2006 resort hotel: five storeys of red-brown brick and cream trim with rows of white-framed windows under a hipped roof, a white columned porte-cochère with a gabled pediment at the entrance, clipped hedges. Two photos (front and corridor). Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
